items.headline: Bottom 10: Week 7's rash of upsets turned everything upside down
items.description: From the Longhorns to the Dawgs, a bunch of top teams bottomed out in Week 7.

items.headline: CUSA matchup features Liberty against Kennesaw State
items.description: Liberty (5-1) at Kennesaw State (1-5), Oct. 22 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Obeid kicks 20-yard FG as time expires, Missouri State beats Kennesaw State 24-21
items.description: — Yousef Obeid kicked a 20-yard field goal as time expired, Henry Belin IV had a career-high 300 yards passing and threw two touchdown passes to Isaiah Myers, and Missouri State defeated Kennesaw State 24-21 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Kennesaw State squares off against Missouri State in CUSA play
items.description: Kennesaw State (1-4) at Missouri State (1-4), Oct. 14 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Garrison Rippa makes field goal with 51 seconds left as Jacksonville State tops Kennesaw State 27-26
items.description: — Garrison Rippa made a go-ahead field goal in the final minute, and Rob Billings IV intercepted a pass seconds later as Jacksonville State beat Kennesaw State 27-26 on Wednesday night in a rematch of the 2025 Conference USA championship game.

items.headline: Jacksonville State takes on Kennesaw State in CUSA play
items.description: Jacksonville State (3-2) at Kennesaw State (1-3), Oct. 7 at 7 p.m. EDT.
